properties.description: Implement the filtering needs agreed in .harness/design/search-filter-needs-analysis.md. Views supply input nodes and edges and own the presentation of filtered results. Reflect only their node/edge type definitions to discover fields; do not recursively fetch related instances. RelationEngine owns query evaluation, primitive/logical operators and reflection; RelationalUi owns the shared composer and autocomplete. Apply query edits manually, reevaluate the applied predicate when data changes, retain ancestors in bushes. Save a flat Windows-user-wide query list outside repositories under %USERPROFILE%\.TheBroccoli; compose saved queries by reference. Agents can discover and complete queries and evaluate the same predicates. Reuse current controls; contributor-specific operators, search presentation and Ctrl+F are deferred. Verify with focused engine, persistence, agent and UI tests, then the checkpoint and rendered review.
properties.title: Develop the shared filtering upgrade
